summary: Converted the source-only fast-apply account into an executed probe: a new experiment on the existing fast-apply question builds six hand-constructed updates and asks setFastApply which apply pass each belongs to (overlapping save/apply ranges, apply tail inside the save range, apply range strictly below the save range, snapshot install, apply-only, save-only). A local run returned exactly the predicted pattern — false for the two overlap cases and the snapshot case, true for the other three. The formal receipt is pending, so no new interpretation was recorded this turn.
